reference_notes.coordinates: Separated points inside reviewed visual envelopes; 12-point exclusion margin around non-exempt other envelopes. Heavy overlap means >=80% of the smaller rectangle. Full button_map.json and annotated atlas are saved locally.
reference_notes.reel_mapping: Upper half retrieves; lower half holds and is not used in this recipe.
reference_notes.requested_reel_count: User requested 10. Fixed mode attempts all 10 unless a bounded stop/error interrupts it; no early catch detection.
reference_notes.timing: 100ms Continue/CAST with zero added delay previously measured 0.468-0.522s request gap and 13.7m followed by four 13.0m casts. Hook wait remains 9.5s after CAST API return. New separated points are tested; repeated transition timing at the new points is not yet measured.
reference_notes.first_cast: Start on CAST with popups closed. First power bar can already be cycling; first cast distance is uncontrolled. Immediate Continue-to-CAST applies between cycles. No other input is scheduled between CAST and HIT.
reference_notes.measured_reel_timing: 0.5s native press plus 0.05s extra pause produced mean API duration 0.822907s and mean dispatch interval 0.933785s. RPC overhead is additional and may vary.
reference_notes.sale: Sell/Continue are fixed timed presses at calibrated points, with no label recognition. Permission for actual scope must already exist.
reference_notes.popups: Always tap the calibrated BUFF confirmation point after result_wait, whether a popup exists or not; wait 0.6s, then Sell. No recognition and no general guarantee for different dialogs or a battle that exceeds the fixed schedule.
reference_notes.native_behavior_validation: Previous points completed five consecutive catches at 100ms CAST/Continue and zero added gap (runs/20261102_154654_815312). Current separated points physically validated in two segments: new CAST/HIT/reel reached a 17.2cm catch; result tail confirm/Sell/Continue returned to CAST. Full uninterrupted updated recipe not yet tested.
reference_notes.energy: User manually enables unlimited-energy pack; script never manages energy.
reference_notes.repair: Unconditional before CAST. Adds Continue-to-CAST delay, minimum distance timing NOT_RUN. Actual repair NOT_RUN.
reference_notes.startup: One startup_continue tap, 0.6s settle, then existing repair/CAST schedule. Compatible by visible geometry with failure/Continue and CAST. Not for waiting/fighting/shop screens.
